# telnyx_calendar_connection (Data Source)

Policy and defaults for a meeting bot calendar connection (Google Calendar or Microsoft Outlook), applied to sessions created for future meetings. A connection is created by completing calendar OAuth in a browser, so create adopts a connection that already exists. Destroy only removes it from Terraform state unless `release_on_destroy` is true, in which case it disconnects the calendar.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `calendar_connection_id` (String) The calendar connection id.

### Read-Only

- `auto_join_policy` (String) all_meetings joins eligible events; external_organizer_excluded requires the connected user to be the organizer; per_meeting requires an explicit opt-in. One of `all_meetings`, `external_organizer_excluded`, `per_meeting`.
- `bot_name` (String) Bot display name; null clears the override.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `default_assistant` (Attributes) Default assistant for future calendar-scheduled Google Meet and Teams sessions. The saved configuration must fit within 8 KiB. Use id, audio_gate, dynamic_variables, and leave_on_end; avatar is not accepted. audio_gate defaults to full_duplex. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_assistant))
- `default_barge_in` (Boolean) Default manual speech interruption. Cannot be true with default_assistant.
- `default_recording` (Boolean) Google Meet and Teams recording intent. When null, recording is enabled only if a destination is set. True requires default_recording_export; false cannot be combined with a destination.
- `default_recording_export` (Attributes) Customer-owned Telnyx Storage destination for recording exports. Uses the authenticated organization and user; do not supply credentials, region, organization ID or object key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_recording_export))
- `default_summarize_on_end` (Boolean) Generate a summary when each future session transcript finalizes.
- `default_voice` (String) Manual-speech voice; must be null when default_assistant is set.
- `default_webhook_url` (String) HTTPS destination for future session webhooks. Null clears the default. A non-null update returns webhook_secret once; save it to verify signatures for sessions created with this default. Existing sessions retain their original signing secret.
- `id` (String) Calendar connection ID.
- `platform` (String) Calendar provider: Google Calendar or Microsoft Outlook.
- `platform_email` (String) Connected calendar email address.
- `status` (String) Connection status.
- `status_detail` (String) Additional connection status detail.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time.

<a id="nestedatt--default_assistant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_assistant`

Read-Only:

- `audio_gate` (String) Audio gating strategy in force for the assistant call leg. One of `full_duplex`, `half_duplex`.
- `dynamic_variables` (String) Dynamic variables in individual-session responses; null when none were supplied. Omitted from session list items. A JSON document; use `jsonencode()`.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the assistant.
- `leave_on_end` (Boolean) Whether the bot leaves when the Assistant's conversation ends or fails.


<a id="nestedatt--default_recording_export"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_recording_export`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Existing accessible bucket. Consecutive dots and IPv4-address names are rejected.
- `prefix` (String) Optional object-key prefix. One trailing slash is normalized. Empty path segments, . and .. segments are rejected.
